name: pivot_root
synopsis: int syscall(SYS_pivot_root, const char *new_root, const char *put_old);
description: pivot_root changes the root mount in the mount namespace of the calling process by moving the current root mount to the specified put_old directory and setting new_root as the new root mount. It requires the CAP_SYS_ADMIN capability and has several restrictions, such as new_root and put_old not being on the same mount as the current root.

parameters.name: new_root
parameters.description: Path to the new root directory, which must be a mount point.

parameters.name: put_old
parameters.description: Path where the old root mount will be moved, which must be at or underneath new_root.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: new_root or put_old is on the current root mount.
new_root is not a mount point; or put_old is not at or underneath new_root; or the current root is not a mount point; or propagation types are invalid.
new_root or put_old is not a directory.
The calling process does not have the CAP_SYS_ADMIN capability.

examples: static int pivot_root(const char *new_root, const char *put_old) { return syscall(SYS_pivot_root, new_root, put_old); }
